Definition: from G3658; companionship ("homily"), i.e. (by implication) intercourse:--communication.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, homilía means communication. It occurs just once, in 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I read homilía plainly: communication, and I leave it there.
